jobs.title: Kitchen Crew
jobs.description:
itiam coffee sedang mencari kitchen crew yang berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. posisi ini bertanggung jawab dalam membantu operasional dapur, menjaga kebersihan area kerja, serta memastikan kualitas penyajian makanan sesuai standar perusahaan. kandidat diharapkan mampu bekerja dalam sistem shift dan memiliki semangat kerja yang tinggi.

kandidat harus pria atau wanita dengan usia maksimal 30 tahun. memiliki sifat jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. mampu belajar dengan cepat serta memiliki kemampuan kerjasama tim yang baik. memiliki komitmen untuk menjaga kebersihan area kerja dan bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. pengalaman di bidang kitchen akan menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Bankir Pemberdaya
jobs.description:
posisi sebagai bankir pemberdaya di btpn syariah. tanggung jawab utama melibatkan interaksi langsung dengan nasabah untuk pemberdayaan ekonomi. benefit yang ditawarkan meliputi pendapatan tetap, thr 2x gaji, insentif, jaminan kesehatan lengkap (bpjs dan asuransi rawat inap), fasilitas tempat tinggal dan kendaraan kerja, program beasiswa s1, hadiah perjalanan ke luar negeri, serta kesempatan ibadah umroh.

perempuan, usia 18-33 tahun. pendidikan minimal sma/sederajat. memiliki kemampuan mengendarai motor. memiliki kepribadian yang senang bersosialisasi dan bertemu dengan banyak orang.

jobs.title: Merchant Succes Executive (Sales)
jobs.description:
bukuwarung sedang mencari merchant succes executive (sales) untuk melakukan akuisisi merchant dan penjualan mesin edc di berbagai wilayah di jawa tengah dan diy. posisi ini bertanggung jawab untuk memperluas jaringan merchant dengan dukungan gaji pokok, tunjangan pulsa dan transportasi, serta jaminan bpjs.

pria atau wanita dengan usia maksimal 35 tahun dan pendidikan minimal sma sederajat. kandidat wajib memiliki pengalaman sebagai sales fmcg, kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, serta memiliki kendaraan roda dua dan sim c aktif. pengalaman dalam menjual mesin edc dan akuisisi sangat diutamakan.

jobs.title: Merchant Succes Executive (Sales)
jobs.description:
kami mencari merchant succes executive (sales) untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. bertanggung jawab untuk meningkatkan penjualan dan mencapai target penjualan. melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetitor, serta membangun hubungan dengan merchant.

laki-laki/wanita usia maks 35 tahun, minimum pendidikan sma sederajat, memiliki pengalaman sebagai sales fmcg, memiliki komunikasi skill yang baik, memiliki kendaraan roda dua, memiliki sim c aktif, pengalaman menjual mesin edc & akuisisi

jobs.title: Marketing, Staff Gudang, Barista
jobs.description:
sbc group membuka lowongan kerja untuk beberapa posisi dan penempatan, meliputi marketing sbk, marketing mebel, marketing accessories, staff gudang, barista, serta marketing untuk cabang karangdinoyo dan cabang ploso. fasilitas yang ditawarkan mencakup peluang pengembangan karier, jaminan dan fasilitas kerja, serta lingkungan kerja positif.

pelamar harus memenuhi kriteria gender sesuai posisi yang dilamar, yaitu marketing sbk (wanita), marketing mebel (pria), marketing accessories (wanita), staff gudang (pria), barista (pria/wanita), marketing cabang karangdinoyo (pria), dan marketing cabang ploso (pria). pelamar diarahkan memindai qr code untuk mengisi data lamaran dan melihat detail informasi lowongan yang tersedia.

jobs.title: Middle Mile Supervisor
jobs.description:
posisi middle mile supervisor di spx express bertanggung jawab untuk memantau dan memimpin operasional middle mile baik dari pihak 3pl maupun internal. tugas utamanya meliputi kolaborasi dengan tim terkait untuk mengelola lead time, durasi pengiriman, dan kebutuhan trip, berkoordinasi dengan tim fleet untuk memastikan kesiapan unit, melakukan pemetaan rute, memaksimalkan penggunaan unit, serta mengalokasikan perencanaan sumber daya untuk implementasi baru di distribution center.

jobs.description:
bertanggung jawab memantau operasional harian sortation center (soc) mencakup pengawasan proses inbound, sortation, bagging, reprocessing, dan outbound. memastikan operasional berjalan sesuai standard operating procedure (sop), merencanakan alokasi tenaga kerja sesuai fluktuasi volume harian, memantau kapasitas serta produktivitas peralatan, dan memimpin pengarahan tim rutin terkait laporan performa kerja serta penerapan 5s.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.description:
posisi sales executive di spx express bertanggung jawab untuk secara proaktif mencari peluang bisnis baru guna meningkatkan angka penjualan. anda akan berperan dalam membangun hubungan jangka panjang dengan klien, memastikan target penjualan tercapai, serta berkoordinasi dengan tim internal untuk memberikan layanan yang melampaui ekspektasi klien. selain itu, anda bertugas memantau tren pasar dan kompetitor untuk terus memperbarui strategi penjualan perusahaan.

kandidat harus merupakan lulusan s1 dengan pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang akuisisi klien. memiliki pengalaman dalam lead generation, akuisisi klien, dan pencapaian target revenue di ranah b2b atau corporate sales sangat diutamakan. pelamar harus komunikatif, percaya diri, mahir melakukan pitching, serta mampu menganalisis kebutuhan klien untuk menyusun proposal solusi dengan pendekatan konsultatif. wajib menguasai microsoft office (word, excel, powerpoint) dan kemampuan berbahasa inggris akan menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Implementation Adviser - PCREEE
jobs.description:
**Description**

The **Pacific Community** (SPC) is the principal scientific and technical organisation in the Pacific region, supporting development since 1947. We are an international development organisation owned and governed by our 27 country and territory members. In pursuit of sustainable development to benefit Pacific people, our unique organisation works across more than 25 sectors. We are known for our knowledge and innovation in such areas as fisheries science, public health surveillance, geoscience, and conservation of plant genetic resources for food and agriculture.

The **Geoscience Energy and Maritime Division** provides advice, technical assistance, research and training support to Pacific Island countries and territories (**PICTs**). There are three (3) areas of scientific programming and two areas of focus within this division:

1. **Oceans and Maritime Programme (OMP)** – assists member countries with services that provide applied ocean science and knowledge for evidence-based policy-making and technical solutions for improved ocean and maritime governance, management and capacity development.
2. **Georesources and Energy Programme (GEP)** – assists member countries by applying technical knowledge in the areas of geoscience and sustainable energy use.
3. **Disaster and Community Resilience Programme (DCRP)** – assists member countries to demonstrate strengthened resilience through integrated action on disaster risk management, climate change adaptation, natural resource management and increased access to water and sanitation.

The **Implementation Adviser – PCREEE** will be pivotal in implementation, delivery and reporting on the annual work programme and budget of the PCREEE during its Third Operational Phase: 2027-2031. The role will work collaboratively with the Manager of the PCREEE as well as the rest of the PCREEE Team, the Georesources and Energy Programme of the GEM Division as well as partners and the Global Network of -Sustainable Energy Centres (GN-SEC).

The key responsibilities of the role include the following:

**Work Programme and Budget Design**

- Design the annual planning and periodically review the PCREEE work programme, portfolio and budget, ensuring alignment with the PCREEE Business Plan, regional priorities, SPC strategic frameworks and donor commitments
- Translate regional energy priorities and identify emerging opportunities, trends into coherent programme strategies, investment priorities, concept notes and initiatives
- Provide technical advice to the PCREEE Manager, governance bodies, and senior stakeholders on programme direction, delivery options, resource requirements and risks
- Maintain continuous engagement through high level stakeholder consultations with governments, development partners, financial institutions and the private sector to shape programme design
- Establish integrated portfolio planning, prioritisation and performance arrangements across PCREEE projects and funding streams

**Work Programme Coordination and Implementation**

- Be responsible for the coordinated implementation and delivery of a complex portfolio of multi-country and multi-donor renewable energy and energy efficiency programmes
- Oversee the development, effective execution and expansion of the national G-RES project portfolio and facilitate SIDS-SIDS cooperation under the GN-SEC/G-RES platforms
- Set delivery priorities, implementation standards and accountabilities across project teams, consultants, secondees and implementing partners, and resolve delivery constraints
- Mobilise and coordinate national and regional expertise, institutional partnerships and implementation capacity across member countries, SPC, CROP agencies, development partners and the private sector.
- Build and maintain high-level partnerships with governments, regional organisations, development partners, financial institutions, industry bodies and private sector stakeholders.
- Oversee programme performance, financial and resource utilisation, quality assurance, procurement dependencies, risk management and compliance with agreed obligations.
- Facilitate regional collaboration and knowledge exchange to strengthen renewable energy and energy efficiency outcomes across Pacific Island countries and territories.
- Supervise and mentor direct report and contribute to building organisational and partner capacity.

**Reporting, Visibility and Knowledge Management**

- Ensure an integrated performance, monitoring, evaluation, learning and reporting framework across the PCREEE portfolio.
- Ensure timely, accurate and high-quality reporting to SPC, donors, and relevant regional frameworks.
- Interpret portfolio evidence, emerging risks and lessons to advise management, support decisions and improve programme design and delivery.
- Set the strategic direction for PCREEE communications, knowledge management, advocacy and visibility, ensuring technical integrity and consistent positioning.
- Oversee the production and dissemination of technical publications, knowledge products, success stories and outreach materials.
- Oversee the preparation of technical publications, knowledge products, success stories and promotional materials.

**Resource Mobilisation and Investment Promotion**

- Engage with governments, donors, climate-finance institutions, development banks, investors and private-sector partners to convert regional priorities and country pipelines into viable financing opportunities.
- Ensure effective governance of the Prospectus Partners Group and maintain current, credible country profiles and project pipelines.
- Design and ensure delivery of regional and national investment forums and dialogues that connect priority projects with finance, technical support and partnerships.
- Develop and advance funding proposals, co-financing arrangements and strategic partnerships that diversify and strengthen the sustainability of the PCREEE portfolio.

For a more detailed account of the key responsibilities, please **refer to the online job description**.

**Key selection criteria**

**Qualifications**

- A postgraduate degree from a recognized institution in a discipline relating to energy or similar field or equivalent body of knowledge and experience.

**Technical expertise**

- At least 10 years of demonstrated technical delivery experience in a national / regional energy office or a similar field.
- Demonstrated experience and success in working with various donors and development partners, the private sector, the academia and the media
- Proven history of successfully planning and coordinating training workshops and investment forums, consultancy studies, consultation and planning meetings as well as awareness and promotional activities.
- Knowledge in key sectors such as agriculture, fisheries, tourism, industry, etc.
- Proven ability to influence work collegially and in partnership with stakeholders and internal partners towards an agreed outcome.
- High-level verbal and written communication skills and the capacity to represent SPC effectively, at regional and international forums.
- Proven ability in project design, management and reporting.
- Ability to work constructively to resolve issues, concerns or differences of opinion.
- Good Financial management skills.

**Language skills**

- Good communication skills in English.

**Interpersonal skills and cultural awareness**

- Knowledge of the Pacific Island countries and understanding context in the Polynesian countries.

**Salary, terms and conditions**

**Contract Duration** – This vacant position is budgeted for 2 years and is subject to renewal depending on funding and performance.

**Remuneration** – the **Implementation Adviser – PCREEE** is a band 11 position in SPC’s 2026 salary scale, with a starting salary range of 3,739–4,632 SDR (special drawing rights) per month, which currently converts to approximately USD 5,010–6,208 (EUR 4,521–5,601). An offer of appointment for an initial contract will normally be made in the lower half of this range, with due consideration being given to experience and qualifications. Progression within the salary scale is based on annual performance reviews. SPC salaries are not presently subject to income tax in Tonga. Tonga nationals employed by SPC in Tonga will be subject to income tax.

**Benefits for Staff in a position advertised internationally (EPAI) whose duty station is** **Nuku’alofa** – SPC provides a housing allowance of USD 1,000–2,000 per month. Establishment and repatriation grant, removal expenses, airfares, home leave travel, health and life and disability insurances and education allowances are available for eligible employees and their eligible dependents. Employees are entitled to 25 working days of annual leave per annum and other types of leave, and access to SPC’s Provident Fund (contributing 8% of salary, to which SPC adds a 10% contribution).

**Languages** – SPC’s working languages are English and French.

**Recruitment principles** – SPC’s recruitment is based on merit and fairness, and candidates are competing in a selection process that is fair, transparent and non-discriminatory. SPC is an **equal-opportunity employer**, and is committed to cultural and gender diversity, including bilinguism, and will seek to attract and appoint candidates who respect these values. Due attention is given to gender equity and the maintenance of strong representation from Pacific Island professionals. If two interviewed candidates are ranked equal by the selection panel, preference will begiven to the **Pacific Islander**. Applicants will be assured of complete confidentiality in line with SPC’s private policy.

jobs.title: Oficial de Logística - Carabobo
jobs.company: Agency for Technical Cooperation and Development
jobs.description:
Acted es una ONG internacional sin ánimo de lucro con sede en París, Francia con operaciones en más de 40 países a nivel mundial. La misión de Acted es aportar asistencia humanitaria inmediata a aquellos que se encuentren en situación de necesidad al mismo tiempo que genera oportunidades a largo plazo para un crecimiento durable. Acted opera en contextos de catástrofe natural, conflicto armado y crisis socioeconómica.

Acted se encuentra en la búsqueda de un/a Oficial de Logística para integrarse a nuestro equipo en la misión de Venezuela.

El/la Oficial de Logística debe garantizar el estricto cumplimiento de los procedimientos logísticos operativos de Acted en respuesta a la emergencia humanitaria post terremoto del 24-06-2026, concentrando las acciones en la zona impactada de Morón, estado Carabobo. Esto implica asegurar que todas las actividades de suministro, almacenamiento, gestión de activos y transporte se realicen bajo las políticas internas de Acted y los estándares exigidos por los donantes, permitiendo así una ejecución fluida de los proyectos que estén en implementación.

**Funciones**

**Gestión de Adquisiciones (Compras)**

- Ejecutar y controlar el ciclo completo de compras: solicitudes, cotizaciones, órdenes de compra y contratos; siguiendo los procedimientos de compras según el escenario respectivo y las políticas de Acted.
- Actuar como punto focal en la relación con proveedores y mantener actualizada la base de datos de los mismos.
- Garantizar que la documentación sobre adquisiciones se realice y archive de acuerdo con los procedimientos de Acted.
- Velar por el cumplimiento de los procesos de validación y firmas de compras, asegurando que las compras y registros pasan entre los equipos logísticos, de finanzas y nivel de coordinación .

**Gestión de Almacén (Stock) y Activos**

- Controlar los procesos de entrada y salida de bienes, manteniendo actualizado el inventario mensual.
- Elaborar y controlar la lista de activos, verificando que cada equipo esté debidamente etiquetado y registrado.
- Garantizar que el personal cuente con el equipamiento necesario y supervisar la devolución de bienes al finalizar misiones.

**Gestión de Flota y Transportes**

- Garantizar el mantenimiento preventivo, implementos de seguridad de las unidades y de los usuarios durante los desplazamientos.
- Apoyar el proceso de planeación logística de desplazamientos en terreno, por medio de revisión de medios de transporte y proveedores de servicios disponibles.

**Informes y Coordinación Interna**

- Elaborar reportes mensuales (TITANICS) y semanales (OFU) sobre el estado de las compras, inventarios y activos.
- Articular las necesidades de los programas con los departamentos de soporte (FLATS) para optimizar la planificación de adquisiciones.
- Apoyar en la sensibilización a proveedores sobre el cumplimiento del código de conducta de la organización.

**Perfil deseado**

**Requisitos**

Obligatorios:

- Profesional titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.
- Mínimo tres (3) años de trayectoria como Logista, preferiblemente en el sector de ONGs internacionales.
- Dominio avanzado del paquete Microsoft Office.
- Experiencia específica en el manejo y control de inventarios
- Experiencia comprobada trabajando en entornos multiculturales.

Competencias:

- Alta atención al detalle, autonomía en la gestión de procesos y habilidades organizativas comprobadas.
- Comunicación asertiva, capacidad para el trabajo en equipo y flexibilidad ante entornos cambiantes.
- Transparencia en el manejo de recursos y responsabilidad en el cumplimiento de normativas.
- Orientación a resultados y dinamismo para la resolución de puntos críticos.

**Condiciones**

- Contrato de prestación de servicios bajo la figura de honorarios profesionales durante 3 meses con posibilidad de renovación según disponibilidad presupuestaria y desempeño.
- Lugar de trabajo: Oficina de Acted en Carabobo.
- Honorarios profesionales según la escala de la organización.
- Prestación de Servicios de forma presencia y traslados frecuentes a zonas afectadas por el doblete sísmico.
- **Moron – Carabobo**

jobs.title: Digital Workplace Platform Administrator
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Candidate Verification Step:** As part of our application process, candidates are asked to complete a brief verification exercise. This will involve including a short cover letter with your application that answers the following question, written in your own words: Describe a recent AI or platform release you had to learn quickly. What did you do with it, and what happened? ***A cover letter is required for your application to be considered, and applications submitted without one cannot move forward.***
**Why we’re asking:** This step helps us confirm that every applicant is a real person and keeps the selection process fair for all candidates. It is not part of your skills assessment, and it will take only a few minutes.

**Job Background / Overview**

The IRC is actively investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations. As the organization expands its use of AI platforms, including tools from Anthropic, OpenAI, and integrated data environments, the IT department is building dedicated technical capacity to keep these systems running reliably, securely, and effectively.

The IRC is investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations. As that investment grows, so does the need for someone to own the technical layer underneath it: the systems, integrations, and infrastructure that make AI tools work at scale.

The AI Platform Engineer is that person. This is a technical operations role, not a user-facing one. This role is responsible for keeping the IRC's enterprise AI environment running managing platform configurations and API access, building and maintaining integrations between AI tools and IRC systems, writing scripts and automations, and serving as the technical point of contact for data engineering and InfoSec. Day-to-day, this person is more likely to be reading logs, troubleshooting a broken pipeline, or pushing a configuration change than answering questions from end users.

The role works in close coordination with the AI Platform Support Director, who owns vendor relationships, licensing, and adoption strategy. This role owns the technical execution underneath that, ensuring the systems are reliable, observable, and properly connected to the rest of the IRC's data and operational environment.

**Major Responsibilities**

**AI Systems Administration & Operations (40%)**

- Serve as primary technical administrator across IRC enterprise AI environments, currently including Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI platform deployments
- Manage user access, API key governance, workspace configurations, and environment-level settings across AI platforms
- Monitor system health, usage patterns, and API performance across AI tools; triage and resolve operational issues as they arise
- Maintain and improve observability across AI systems
- Tracking uptime, error rates, token consumption, and integration reliability
- Oversee and document configuration changes, environment updates, and deployment procedures across managed platforms
- Support responsible use by flagging anomalous usage patterns and coordinating with InfoSec on policy adherence and access controls

**Integrations & Technical Implementation (35%)**

- Coordinate with the DevOps, SW Engineering and Data Engineering team(s) on deployment processes, environment access, and infrastructure dependencies required to build and maintain AI integrations
- Follow established change management procedures for all configuration changes, environment updates, and integration deployments, including documentation, testing, and appropriate approvals before pushing to production
- Develop lightweight scripts, connectors, and automations to support AI-assisted workflows across teams, primarily in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
- Troubleshoot integration failures, data flow issues, and API connectivity problems across the AI ecosystem
- Collaborate with the data engineering team on AI/KM pipeline work, including vector store ingestion, retrieval configuration, and source data connections
- Contribute to technical design discussions with engineering partners, translating operational requirements into implementable solutions
- Maintain technical documentation for all integrations, including architecture notes, runbooks, and dependency maps

**Monitoring, Resource Optimization & InfoSec Liaison (15%)**

- Track and report on AI resource utilization across platforms, identifying opportunities to reduce waste and improve cost efficiency in coordination with the AI
- Serve as the technical point of contact with the InfoSec team on matters related to AI system security, data handling, access controls, and compliance requirements
- Support risk assessments and security reviews for new AI tools or integrations by providing accurate technical context on system behavior and data flows
- Contribute to the development of technical SOPs and best-practice guidelines for AI system use, in coordination with the AI Platform Support Director and relevant stakeholders

**Stakeholder Support & Collaboration (10%)**

- Act as a technical resource for program and operations teams adopting AI tools, including answering implementation questions, supporting troubleshooting, and identifying configuration solutions
- Participate in rollout planning for new AI capabilities, providing grounded input on technical feasibility, integration requirements, and operational readiness
- Collaborate with the AI Platform Support Director on onboarding documentation and technical guidance materials for end users
- Contribute to sprint and project planning with accurate estimates on technical effort and dependencies

**Required Experience & Skills**

**AI & Cloud Platforms**

- Hands-on experience administering enterprise AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or comparable tools), including API management, access controls, and environment configuration
- Familiarity with LLM application infrastructure: prompt pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP), other tool-calling integration frameworks, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and embedding workflows
- Experience working with Databricks or comparable data/ML platforms is a strong plus

**Integration & Development**

- Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript for scripting, automation, and lightweight integration work
- Experience building and maintaining REST API integrations, including authentication patterns, webhook handling, and error management
- Comfort reading and working within existing codebases without requiring significant architectural guidance
- Familiarity with version control (Git) and standard deployment practices for scripts and integrations

**Systems Administration & Monitoring**

- Experience monitoring distributed systems or SaaS platforms, including setting up alerting, reviewing logs, and diagnosing performance or availability issues
- Familiarity with usage/cost monitoring for cloud or API-based services
- Comfort operating in live production environments where reliability and data integrity are critical

**Security & Compliance**

- Working knowledge of information security principles as they apply to SaaS and API-based systems: access controls, credential management, data handling, and audit logging
- Ability to engage constructively with InfoSec teams, providing clear technical context to support reviews and risk assessments

**Collaboration & Communication**

- Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and program staff
- Experience contributing to cross-functional teams alongside product, engineering, and operations stakeholders
- Strong documentation habits: runbooks, SOPs, architecture notes, and internal guides

**Working Environment**

This role is remote, with the possibility of in-person work depending on location. Stakeholders are located across multiple time zones (GMT-8 to GMT+3), which may require occasional early or late meetings.

**Compensation:** ($88,277 - $102,451/annual). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in [IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct](https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct). Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on [Safeguarding](https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding), Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

**Benefits:** IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Programme Assistant
jobs.description:
## Description

The **Pacific Community (SPC)** is the principal scientific and technical organisation in the Pacific region, supporting development since 1947. We are an international development organisation owned and governed by our 27 country and territory members. In pursuit of sustainable development to benefit Pacific people, our organisation works across more than 25 sectors. We are known for our knowledge and innovation in such areas as fisheries science, public health surveillance, geoscience, and conservation of plant genetic resources for food and agriculture.

The **Land Resources Division (LRD)** provides effective expert scientific advice, capacity building and services on conservation, development and utilization of plant genetic resources, forest and landscape management, resilient agricultural systems, diversification of livelihood strategies and access to markets to maintain ecosystem services and improve land productivity and the food, nutrition security and resilience of Pacific communities. LRD has expertise in genetic resource conservation, resilient agriculture, biosecurity, pest and disease management, agricultural extension, plant pathology, entomology and animal health. It collaborates with governments, regional organisations, civil society and other SPC divisions to pinpoint the needs and priorities of Pacific countries and communities and provide technical expertise to address them. This mission is realized through four main thematic work areas, or pillars, and a progressively integrated approach to programming that works towards achieving SPC’s development goals.

The role – **Senior Programme Assistant** will provide support to the “EU-ACP Business-Friendly: Supporting value chains through inclusive policies, investment promotion, alliances and access to finance” Project with the administrative and financial delivery of the project in accordance with SPC and Donor requirements. Responsibilities include support for program accounting, audit, financial monitoring, procurement and grants services, workshop and travel support, financial acquittals and general administration. The role will also support other work under the Natural Resource Management Programme of LRD when required.

The key responsibilities of the role include:

**Finance Support Services**

- Support the preparation of donor financial reports and subsequent invoices for funding tranche requests as per signed agreements.
- Monitor project expenditure against approved budget monthly.
- Ensure financial transactions comply with SPC’s Financial guidelines.
- Support grant monitoring and liaison with beneficiaries on financial tranches and acquittals.

**Procurement Support Services**

- Support the project team with the development and regular updating of the annual procurement plan.
- Ensure all project procurements comply with SPC’s Procurement guidelines.
- Provide support to the project team in drafting RFQ’s and high value procurement.
- Assist with vendor identification, liaison including negotiation of payment terms in line with SPC procurement guidelines.

**Travel and Workshops Support Services**

- Manage travel requirements for staff and external participants, including liaising with SPC travel team, travel agents on itinerary and tickets, and updating the SPC travel system.
- Inform and guide staff/consultants/partners/ donors on SPC travel compliance procedures as well specific travel compliance procedures for their nominated country/territory of travel.
- Ensure travel is budgeted for and in line with work plan.
- Support the development of budgets for regional workshops and field travel needs.

**Administration Support**

- Manage day-to-day administration and operations work for the project.
- Manage and monitor project filing systems, including the archiving and backup of project documents, information, and data in a format suitable for audits and evaluations.
- Manage project assets records, including facilitating asset transfers/disposals.
- Provide backstopping support to other project teams within LRD when required.

For a more detailed account of the key responsibilities, please **refer to the online job description**.

## Key selection criteria

**Qualifications**

- A Diploma in a relevant field such as finance, business administration, procurement or equivalent body of knowledge and experience.

**Technical expertise**

- 7 years of experience in the provision of project support within a medium to large sized organisation in a similar institution or environment.
- Demonstrated experience in donor project finance, procurement and/or administration.
- Very good experience in logistics management inclusive of travel for workshops and training programs.
- Excellent team player with ability to work autonomously.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office suites, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Proficiently able to use SharePoint platforms such as Microsoft teams, Zoom, etc.

**Language skills**

- Excellent English communication skills (oral and written).

**Interpersonal skills and cultural awareness**

- Ability to work in a multicultural, inclusive and equitable environment.

## Salary, terms and conditions

**Contract Duration** – **Until 30 September 2027** – subject to renewal depending on funding and performance.

**Remuneration –** The **Senior Programme Assistant** is a band 7 position in SPC’s 2026 salary scale, with a commencing taxable salary range of FJD 2,402-3,002 per month, plus local staff benefits. An offer of appointment for an initial contract will normally be made in the lower half of this range, with due consideration given to experience and qualifications. Progression within the salary scale will be based on annual performance reviews.

**Benefits for Staff in a position advertised locally (EPAL) whose duty station is Suva –** SPC provides medical and life insurance for eligible employees only. Employees are entitled to 25 working days of annual leave per annum and other types of leave, prorated on contract length, and access to Fiji’s National Provident Fund (contributing 8% of salary, to which SPC adds a 10% contribution).

**Recruitment principles** –SPC’s recruitment is based on merit and fairness, and candidates are competing in a selection process that is fair, transparent and non-discriminatory. SPC is an **equal-opportunity employer**, and is committed to cultural and gender diversity, including bilingualism, and will seek to attract and appoint candidates who respect these values. Due attention is given to gender equity and the maintenance of strong representation from Pacific Island professionals. If two interviewed candidates are ranked equal by the selection panel, preference will be given to the **Pacific Islander**.

Applicants will be assured of complete confidentiality in line with SPC’s Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: IT Business Relationship Director, Americas
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Job Overview**

We are hiring an IT Business Relationship Director to ensure IT service delivery meets the operational needs of program offices across the Americas geography (US and LATAM), translating business needs into IT priorities and IT technical capability into business value. The role sits at the intersection of IT and program operations — building trust with leadership, diagnosing where IT processes break down, and brokering the cross-office knowledge and escalation paths that don't currently exist structurally.

This role will operate as the connective layer between IT and Resettlement, Asylum and Integration (RAI) and Crisis, Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) leadership across the US and LATAM, working alongside the Global IT Solutions team, the Americas IT Service Desk (POD) and RAI Operations staff. They will build a regular engagement cadence with RAI office and CRRD program leadership, develop enough programmatic fluency to judge whether an IT solution will work in the field, own escalations, knowing when an issue needs IT leadership, a vendor, or executive attention. The role embeds proactive communication and cross-office knowledge-sharing into how IT and program operations work together, so that consistency across offices is structural rather than dependent on individual relationships.

The ideal candidate has direct experience in complex, distributed program operations, and brings credibility with program leadership as a result — not just IT service management experience. They are equal parts relationship manager, translator, and escalation owner: able to build trust with operations staff, assess whether a proposed IT solution will hold up in the field, and judge when to resolve something directly versus route it structurally. They have a bias for proactive communication, a high bar for consistency across offices, and a clear instinct for equipping program and office staff with the tools, access, and know-how to handle their own work.

This role reports to the Senior Director, IT Business Relationship Management and partners closely with RAI and CRRD leadership through an agreed engagement model. The role will also work closely with the Global IT Solutions Team, including the Service Delivery Center of Excellence, Helpdesk team, Enterprise Applications and Infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Relationship Management and Engagement**

- Serve as the senior IT partner to RAI office and CRRD program leadership, providing strategic guidance and thought partnership on IT service delivery performance, planned initiatives, and emerging risks across the US and LATAM
- Maintain a regular engagement cadence with RAI operations directors and senior CRRD leadership, ensuring IT priorities are aligned with program needs and that leadership has visibility of service delivery against commitments
- Act as the accountable IT point of contact for escalations from office and program leadership — owning the response, not just the routing
- Build sufficient familiarity with the programmatic context of each cluster to advise credibly on whether IT solutions will work in practice, and to represent office needs accurately to HQ IT
- Own cross-office knowledge brokering — surfacing what's working in one office to others, and serving as the connective point for "what are other offices doing on this?" questions that currently have no structural answer
- Act as the strategic focal point for IT initiative rollouts across RAI offices and CRRD programs in the Americas – shaping appropriate timing, delivery and relaying infrastructure, application, and programmatic IT needs from offices to HQ IT teams and vice versa.
- Support IT budget planning for the Americas region and ensure asset documentation, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance obligations are maintained

**Escalation, Risk Management and Service Performance**

- Own escalation pathways for issues that fall between the helpdesk and engineering teams, knowing when to involve specific IT leads, vendors, or procurement and following through to resolution
- Monitor service delivery performance and key performance indicators across the Americas region, identifying patterns and recurring issues that should trigger problem management review; escalate trending patterns as they emerge for either immediate action, system enhancement, or larger risk management
- Partner with the Global Service Desk Manager on T1/T2 technician performance, ensuring ticket priority logic and SLA adherence

**Job Requirements:**

**Knowledge & Experience**

- 6-8 years in a relationship management, business partnering, or program/operations role bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders — direct experience with humanitarian, nonprofit, or similarly complex distributed-operations environments strongly preferred
- Working knowledge of the IT service and technology lifecycle, from planning and delivery through operations and continuous improvement, sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams and evaluate whether a proposed solution is fit for purpose
- Familiarity with IT best-practice frameworks and delivery models (e.g., ITIL, Agile/Scrum, or equivalent project delivery methodologies) and how they apply to service management and technology rollouts; ITIL Foundation certification preferred, not required
- Demonstrated experience translating operational needs into technical priorities and representing technical capability back to non-technical leadership
- Experience defining and tracking performance metrics (KPIs, SLAs, or equivalent) and running a recurring review cadence with stakeholders

**Personal Attributes**

- Spanish language proficiency
- Builds credibility quickly with leadership
- Comfortable holding ambiguity and structuring it
- Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate fluently between technical and program audiences

**Working Environment*****:***

This position is based in the US – Hybrid. The role may require travel to US and LATAM Offices as necessary.

**Compensation:** (Pay Rate: $132,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in [IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct](https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct). Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on [Safeguarding](https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding), Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

**Benefits:** IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.

IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Especialista de Recuperación Económica (Agropecuario) - Caracas (Staff National)
jobs.description:
El Consejo Dánes para refugiados es una de las ONG humanitarias líderes en el mundo, que trabaja en más de 40 países para brindar asistencia y protección adecuadas a refugiados, solicitantes de asilo, desplazados internos, retornados, personas en movimiento y población local vulnerable/comunidades de acogida. Actualmente, DRC está buscando un **Especialista de Recuperación Económica - Agropecuario** altamente calificado con sede en **Caracas, Venezuela.**

**Acerca del trabajo:**

DRC está administrando sus operaciones en Venezuela, bajo la dirección de la oficina de país en Caracas y tres oficinas de campo ubicadas en los estados de Sucre, Apure y Zulia. DRC Venezuela está implementando actividades como monitoreo de protección, asistencia legal, asistencia de protección individual para PWSN, sesiones informativas para PoC, prevención de trata de personas, rehabilitación de infraestructura de salud y seguridad alimentaria.

**DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DEL CARGO:**

Bajo la supervisión del Jefe de Programas, y con el lineamiento técnico de la Coordinación de Recuperación Económica, el/la Especialista Agropecuario será la referencia técnica nacional de DRC Venezuela para el componente agropecuario de los programas de Seguridad Alimentaria y Medios de Vida. Su función principal es brindar acompañamiento técnico a los Oficiales Agropecuarios de las bases, y garantizar la calidad, coherencia y sostenibilidad de las intervenciones productivas en todo el país.

El/la Especialista desarrollará documentos metodológicos, lineamientos técnicos y mecanismos de evaluación de la productividad de los medios de vida apoyados. También liderará la generación de propuestas innovadoras adaptadas al clima, orientadas a la generación de ingresos y a la producción de alimentos para el autoconsumo.

El cargo adopta un enfoque de nexus humanitario–desarrollo, orientado a transitar de la respuesta inmediata hacia soluciones duraderas. Para ello, integra el fortalecimiento de cadenas de valor, sistemas productivos resilientes, soluciones basadas en la naturaleza (SbN) y el uso de información agroclimática, con el fin de reducir la vulnerabilidad de los hogares en situación de crisis frente a riesgos ambientales y eventos climáticos extremos. Estas acciones se desarrollan en articulación con los sectores de Protección, WASH y Preparación para Desastres, así como con actores locales e institucionales.

**PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES**

**Responsabilidades:**

**Acompañamiento técnico a los equipos de terreno**

- Brindar asistencia técnica continua, presencial y remota, a los Oficiales Agropecuarios de las bases en la planificación, ejecución y cierre técnico de las actividades agropecuarias.
- Identificar prioridades técnicas y brechas de capacidad en los equipos, y diseñar planes de fortalecimiento (formaciones, guías prácticas, intercambios entre bases).
- Realizar visitas de acompañamiento y control de calidad en terreno para verificar que los servicios cumplan los estándares técnicos de DRC.
- Ejercer la supervisión técnica de los Oficiales Agropecuarios y asegurar enfoques homogéneos entre bases, adaptados a cada contexto.
- Acompañar la transferencia de metodologías de DRC a socios locales y organizaciones comunitarias.

**Desarrollo de metodologías y lineamientos técnicos**

- Elaborar y actualizar documentos metodológicos y lineamientos técnicos nacionales: diagnósticos productivos, criterios de selección de oficios productivos, paquetes tecnológicos por rubro y especificaciones técnicas de insumos y equipos.
- Desarrollar guías y currículos de formación en prácticas agropecuarias sostenibles, agroecológicas y climáticamente inteligentes, sensibles a riesgos de protección.
- Definir criterios técnicos mínimos para subsistemas productivos de pequeña escala: hortalizas y patios productivos, avícola, porcícola, acuícola, cultivos de ciclo corto y perennes.
- Integrar en los lineamientos los enfoques transversales de nutrición, WASH (uso seguro y eficiente del agua), género, protección y gestión del riesgo.

**Cadenas de valor, sistemas productivos y soluciones duraderas**

- Liderar análisis de mercado y de cadenas de valor para identificar rubros con potencial de sostenibilidad, resiliencia y viabilidad comercial para las Personas de Interés (PdI).
- Orientar la evaluación de viabilidad técnica, económica, social y ambiental de iniciativas productivas individuales y asociativas.
- Promover la articulación de productores con mercados, proveedores de insumos, servicios financieros y redes de comercialización.
- Diseñar rutas de graduación que acompañen a los hogares desde la producción de subsistencia hacia la generación de ingresos y la autosuficiencia.
- Integrar el enfoque de nexo: vincular la respuesta de emergencia con la recuperación temprana y el desarrollo, mediante alianzas con autoridades locales, academia, sector privado y organizaciones comunitarias.

**Innovación, adaptación climática y soluciones basadas en la naturaleza**

- Generar propuestas técnicas innovadoras adaptadas al clima, orientadas a la generación de ingresos o de alimentos para la subsistencia.
- Incorporar soluciones basadas en la naturaleza en el diseño de las intervenciones: agroforestería, conservación de suelos, cosecha de agua, manejo integrado de plagas, diversificación de cultivos y semillas locales.
- Promover el uso de información agroclimática (calendarios agrícolas, pronósticos, alertas tempranas) para la toma de decisiones productivas.
- Coordinar con Preparación para Desastres la integración de la gestión del riesgo agroclimático en los planes productivos y comunitarios.
- Identificar y sistematizar buenas prácticas y experiencias piloto para su escalamiento.

**Monitoreo, evaluación de la productividad y reporte**

- Diseñar mecanismos y herramientas para evaluar la productividad de los medios de vida apoyados: rendimientos, costos de producción, ingresos, autoconsumo y supervivencia de los emprendimientos.
- Desarrollar, junto con MEAL, indicadores, líneas base y de salida, encuestas PDM y planes de seguimiento productivo.
- Monitorear los programas frente a los productos y resultados esperados, y analizar la información para ajustar la programación.
- Apoyar la supervisión de la ejecución financiera y presupuestaria del componente agropecuario.
- Elaborar informes técnicos para donantes y para la gerencia, y mantener actualizada la documentación de los proyectos.
- Documentar lecciones aprendidas, casos de éxito e historias de vida.

**Diseño de programas y nuevas oportunidades**

- Diseñar y realizar evaluaciones de necesidades para orientar el diseño programático y la dirección estratégica, incluidas evaluaciones rápidas en emergencias en coordinación con otros actores.
- Contribuir, junto con el Jefe de programas, la Coordinación de Recuperación Económica y la unidad de Grants,
- a la elaboración de propuestas, notas conceptuales y presupuestos de calidad para el componente agropecuario.
- Identificar nuevas oportunidades de financiamiento y alianzas estratégicas.
- Contribuir al desarrollo de la estrategia nacional de Recuperación Económica y traducirla en planes de acción operativos.

**Coordinación externa y representación**

- Representar a DRC en espacios técnicos de coordinación: Grupo de trabajo de medios de vida agrícolas, espacios técnicos con la FAO y otras agencias de la ONU.
- Compartir información relevante de los proyectos con las partes interesadas.
- Coordinar con autoridades locales, instituciones técnicas, academia y socios nacionales.

**Experiencias y competencias técnicas:** (Incluir años de experiencia)

- Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en proyectos agropecuarios o de medios de vida rurales con ONG internacionales, agencias de la ONU o cooperación, preferiblemente en contextos de crisis humanitaria o recuperación.
- Experiencia brindando asistencia técnica, formación o supervisión técnica a equipos de campo en varias zonas o bases.
- Experiencia demostrada en la elaboración de documentos técnicos, metodologías, guías y lineamientos.
- Experiencia en diseño de proyectos, formulación de propuestas y presupuestos, y reportes a donantes.
- Experiencia de trabajo con socios nacionales, autoridades locales y organizaciones de la ONU.
- Se valora experiencia en una oficina regional o nacional, y en coordinación intersectorial (Protección, WASH, Preparación para Desastres).
- Habilidades de redacción de informes y otros documentos de comunicación interna.
- Excelente habilidad en MS Word, Excel y PowerPoint.
- Experiencia en manejar bases de datos.

**Conocimientos técnicos**

- **Cadenas de valor y mercados:** análisis de mercado, enfoque de sistemas de mercado, articulación comercial y asociatividad.
- **Sistemas productivos:** producción vegetal y animal de pequeña escala, agroecología, patios productivos, manejo pecuario y sanidad básica.
- **Soluciones basadas en la naturaleza:** agroforestería, conservación y restauración de suelos, manejo de cuencas y agua, biodiversidad agrícola.
- **Agroclima y adaptación:** agricultura climáticamente inteligente, análisis de riesgo agroclimático, uso de información climática y alertas tempranas.
- **Economía agropecuaria:** estructuras de costos, rentabilidad, gestión de negocios agropecuarios y medición de productividad.
- **Enfoque de nexo y soluciones duraderas:** recuperación temprana, programación de graduación y resiliencia.
- **Monitoreo y análisis de datos:** diseño de indicadores y herramientas, manejo de bases de datos.

**Educacion**

- Profesionales con título de educación superior relacionado a Ingeniería Agrónoma, Ingeniería de Producción animal, Agroecología, Ingeniería Ambiental, Medicina Veterinaria, Zootecnia, Ingeniería Agropecuaria, Biología o carreras afines.

**Languages**

- Español fluido, oral y escrito.
- Conocimiento intermedio/avanzado de inglés será considerado una ventaja, particularmente para acceder a lineamientos y recursos técnicos globales.

**Ofrecemos:**

- La oportunidad de pertenecer a una de las mejores ONGs a nivel mundial.
- Acceso a más de 1,000 capacitaciones y certificados en línea gratuita.
- Duración del contrato: según disponibilidad presupuestal.
- Salario: **Banda G**
- Seguro HCM cubierto en su totalidad por la organización.

**Competencias Básicas de DRC:**

- **Lograr la excelencia**: centrarse en alcanzar resultados y garantizar procesos eficientes.
- **Colaboración:** involucrar a las partes relevantes y alentar la retroalimentación.
- **Tomar la iniciativa**: tomar posesión e iniciativa mientras se busca la innovación.
- **Comunicar:** escuchar y hablar con eficacia y honestidad.
- **Demostración de integridad**:

**Proceso de solicitud:** Todos los solicitantes deben cargar una carta de presentación (máx. 1 página) y un CV actualizado (**máx. 2 páginas, sin soportes**) en español, en la plataforma de empleo de DRC. Las solicitudes enviadas por correo electrónico no serán consideradas.

**Fecha de cierre de solicitudes**: Domingo 15 de Noviembre a las 11:59 pm Hora Local. Tenga en cuenta que las solicitudes se revisarán continuamente y las entrevistas se planificarán tan pronto como se identifique a un candidat@ adecuado. DRC se reserva el derecho a cerrar la vacante antes de la fecha límite una vez se identifique a un candidato idóneo.
